description: This file defines a React component 'NetworkResourceDetails' and related subcomponents for displaying detailed network resource information in a trace viewer, including headers, payload, response, and supporting functionalities like copying requests and formatting response bodies.

classes.name: RequestBody
classes.description: Type alias for request body object containing text and optional mimeType, or null.

classes.name: CopyDropdown
classes.description: React component providing a dropdown menu to copy network request in various formats.

classes.name: ExpandableSection
classes.description: React component for expandable sections displaying headers, query params, or request body.

classes.name: HeadersTab
classes.description: React component displaying headers and general info of a network resource.

classes.name: PayloadTab
classes.description: React component displaying request payload and query string parameters.

classes.name: ResponseTab
classes.description: React component displaying the response body, including images, fonts, or text.

classes.name: FontPreview
classes.description: React component for previewing font data loaded from response.

methods.name: statusClass
methods.description: Returns CSS class based on HTTP status code for coloring status indicator.

methods.name: formatXml
methods.description: Formats XML string with indentation for readability.

methods.name: formatBody
methods.description: Formats response body based on content type, handling JSON, XML, and URL-encoded data.
